text:
Harper: Zenith Micro reached out for a joint perf/W + throughput run focusing on mixed-precision kernel paths and memory-bandwidth impacts. They suggested Wed 2026-07-15.

Devon: Sounds good. Key asks: per-GPU power, PCIe/NVLink bandwidth counters, tokens/s, and memory copy latency. Also need a reproducible container we both run.

KernelBot: Recommended sweep knobs: precision_path(fp32/fp16/q8_0/q4_nop), tile_size(16/32/64), mem_copy(async/sync). Default reps=4, warmup=30s, measure=90s.

Harbor CI Bot: Harbor slot availability Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Upload prefix s3://redwood-partner-zenith/2005007777/. Accepts docker tag redwood/bench:partner-zenith.

Legal: Quick reminder: publishable outputs must be aggregated CSVs only. No serials, no internal build hashes. If Zenith requests per-GPU numbers in the public note, they must provide written consent.

Marketing: We'll want two publishable configs: "memory-bound-efficiency" (batch=1, seq=1024, q4_nop) and "compute-bound-throughput" (batch=16, seq=512, fp16). Need logo and claim sign-off, request 48h embargo post-validation.

Devon: Draft sweep CSV (minimal):
precision,tile_size,mem_copy
fp16,32,async
q4_nop,16,async
fp32,64,sync
q8_0,32,async

Harbor CI Bot: Slot reserved: Wed 02:30 UTC on harbor-ci-3. Notification to this thread when logs uploaded.

Harper: Runbook snippet for the partner container README:
```
export REDWOOD_UPLOAD=s3://redwood-partner-zenith/2005007777/$RUN_ID
export REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=partner-s3
./run_bench --model opt-6.7B --batch $BATCH --seq $SEQ --warmup 30 --reps 4 \
  --sweep-file sweep.csv --measure 90 --upload $REDWOOD_UPLOAD
```
Make sure to set REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=disabled for compute-bound runs.

KernelBot: Note: record PCIe TX/RX and NVLink counters if available, and include memcopy latency histogram in artifacts. Label power source (PDU vs GPU sensor).

Legal: I'll prepare a one-paragraph publishable methodology that states measurement windows, warmup exclusion, and aggregation method. Will request Zenith's legal sign-off.

Devon: Dashboard ask: Console widgets for tokens/s over time, perf_per_watt scatter by config, p95 latency heatmap, and an artifact link to summary.json. Add auto-regression: tokens/s drop >10% or perf/W drop >7% triggers #eng-runtime.

Marketing: Draft headline options: "Redwood + Zenith: Tuned runtime delivers memory-aware perf/W gains" or "Mixed-precision kernels unlock 2x perf/W on Zenith silicon". Will choose after numbers.

Harbor CI Bot: Run completed: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-partner-zenith/2005007777/logs.tar.gz (link: https://s3.example/zenith/2005007777/logs.tar.gz). Summary at s3://redwood-partner-zenith/2005007777/summary.json.

Harper: Great, I'll parse the summary and post aggregated CSV for legal review. Quick note: tag any public artifacts with both company names and include the instrumentation appendix.

Devon: I'll follow up with a short kernel-tuning note describing q8_0 path behavior on Zenith memory topology.

Legal: Once aggregated CSVs and the methodology are in, I'll circulate the publishable blurb to Zenith legal. Keep raw logs internal only.

Marketing: Thanks all. Please confirm embargo window of 48h after legal sign-off.

Harper: Action items recap: (1) Devon 	6 parse summary + kernel note (due in 2h). (2) Legal 	6 draft publishable methodology + circulation (due EOD). (3) Marketing 	6 request Zenith brand assets + prepare headline drafts (due EOD). (4) Harbor CI Bot 	6 confirm artifacts uploaded (done).

Harbor CI Bot: Confirmation: summary.json and logs.tar.gz present at the upload path.

Devon: Parsed and attached aggregated CSV to internal S3 path s3://redwood-partner-zenith/2005007777/publishable.csv. Posting brief numbers: compute-bound fp16: 1.9x perf/W vs baseline fp32; memory-bound q4_nop: 2.6x perf/W at 12% higher p95.

Harper: Thanks. Legal and Marketing, please proceed. Closing thread after legal confirms publishable scope.
